Container.Name: ha-edu-portal
Container.Overview:
Educational Portal for Home Assistant - A web-based portal for managing multiple Home Assistant demo instances for educational purposes. Perfect for classroom environments where students need hands-on experience.
Features: - Easy instance creation with web interface - Admin password protected deletion and reset - Teacher Access: Optional feature to add teacher admin accounts to student instances - Instance reset functionality - Automatic port assignment with port reuse - Network isolation with internet access - Built-in proxy - access all instances through port 5000 - Cloudflare tunnel ready - Pre-configured demo entities (lights, weather, thermostat, etc.)
Access the portal at http://[IP]:[PORT:5000]

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for accessing the HA-Edu portal web interface. All instances are accessed through this single port via built-in proxy.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket for managing Home Assistant containers. Required for creating and managing instances.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Directory for storing instance data and configuration

Config.Name: Base Port
Config.Description: Starting port number for Home Assistant instances. Ports are assigned dynamically starting from this value (internal only, not exposed to host).

Config.Name: Data File Path
Config.Description: Path to store instance data within the container. Usually does not need to be changed.

Config.Name: Home Assistant Image
Config.Description: Home Assistant Docker image to use for instances. Change to use a specific version or different image.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: REQUIRED admin password for delete and reset operations. If not set, delete and reset operations will fail. Store this securely!

Config.Name: Teacher Username
Config.Description: OPTIONAL username for teacher admin account. Required for Teacher Access feature. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: Teacher Password
Config.Description: OPTIONAL password for teacher admin account. Required for Teacher Access feature. Leave empty to disable.
